Around [[3712 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]] embarked on an '''expedition''' to find more [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] colonies. A staunch believer in the purity of Sith blood, Ikoral took a number of purebloods with him aboard his flagship ''[[Red Reaper]]''.<ref name="Red Reaper">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Red Reaper}}</ref> After [[Darth Ikoral's fleet]] went missing and the Sith Lord was presumed [[Death/Legends|dead]],<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Ikoral returned seventy [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] first set off and attacked both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Red Reaper" />
